offices.text: builds up towers and furnishes them with ammunition and weapons
sends men of war to places appointed

goetia.textus: (38.) Halphas , or Malthus .—The Thirty-eighth Spirit is Halphas, or Malthous (or Malthas). He is a Great Earl, and appeareth in the Form of a Stock-Dove. He speaketh with a hoarse Voice. His Office is to build up Towers, and to furnish them with Ammunition and Weapons, and to send Men-of-War to places appointed. He ruleth over 26 Legions of Spirits, and his Seal is this, etc.
forma: He is a Great Earl, and appeareth in the Form of a Stock-Dove.
He speaketh with a hoarse Voice.

reticentia: the witnesses are silent on his truthfulness
